interventions.detail: Built the wheel from source (scripts/publish_pypi.py build infra) instead of pip install from PyPI, so the repo's data/ rules are bundled
Installed Go 1.23.12 toolchain from go.dev; needed to compile cmd/cli, not mentioned in README
Installed python 'build', setuptools and wheel in a uv venv (Python 3.12), which the build script needs
